newsitem.title: UK: EMU in Britain's interests-Lib-Dems say.
newsitem.headline: EMU in Britain's interests-Lib-Dems say.

text.p: A single European currency is the best framework in which to achieve lower inflation and create exchange rate stability and it is in Britain's interest to take part, the minority Liberal Democrats said in their election manifesto on Friday.

But the party said three conditions had to be met before Britain joined -- the single currency had to be firmly founded on the Maastricht criteria, Britain had to meet those criteria and there had to be a Yes' vote in a British referendum.
"If these conditions for a single currency are in place, Britain should join," the manifesto said.
It also pledged to turn the Bank of England into a U.K. Reserve Bank free from political interference and charged with keeping inflation low.
